slides.headline: Shop to Cave Point in 4 turns.
slides.body: About 4 miles of quiet country roads. Swipe for every turn.

slides.headline: Left on Lake Shore Road.
slides.body: Half a mile on Hwy 57, then off the highway for good.

slides.headline: Left on Cave Point Drive.
slides.body: About a mile under the trees. This is the pretty part.

slides.headline: Left on Schauer Road.
slides.body: A mile and a half more, straight to the park.

slides.headline: Cave Point.
slides.body: Park the bike and walk to the ledge. Windy days bring the show.

slides.headline: Add Whitefish Dunes.
slides.body: About 1.5 more miles on Schauer and Clark Lake Road. Bikes stay on bike routes in the park.

slides.headline: Book 2 hours. No rush back.
slides.body: Pick the 2-hour rental and we stop the clock. Ride until you're done.

slides.headline: Single file. Stay right. Signal.
slides.body: These are quiet roads, but cars still use them. Lights on if it's gray.

slides.headline: 57. Lake Shore. Cave Point Dr. Schauer.
slides.body: Three lefts after the highway. About 4 miles. The motor handles the hills.

slides.headline: Screenshot the map. Grab a bike.
slides.body: Fat-tire e-bike rentals in Jacksonport. Send this to whoever's navigating.
